data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Was very excited to try…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a5e15dc934cedd0ce7a88f6)
Was very excited to try Lulu and Georgia. After paying about $500 for bedding, I learned I would also be charged around $60 for shipping. You really cant cover shipping? In addition, I tried the bedding out, as any normal person would, and learned that you cannot return bedding unless it is completely unopened. How are you suppose to know if you like it? I did not sleep in it or use it, why would you not accept returns? I would also have to pay again to ship the return back. I wish I would have read the fine print. I’ve never seen such a strict return policy. Customers value flexibility, and Lulu and Georgia provides none. Sadly, I will not be a returning buyer.

July 6, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 20, 2026

Hi Anna,

Thank you for your review. We are sincerely sorry for the frustration and disappointment surrounding our shipping fees and return policies.

We apologize that this left you with a negative impression of our brand, and we have shared your feedback regarding customer flexibility directly with our team.
